description: AmberX voice phrases for toolbar widgets (toolbar-widgets@1). They are console-control voice intents (framework/core/engines/console-control-voice.mjs, Python twin server/console_control.py voice_intent): each phrase becomes a press on function:toolbar.widget with value <toolbar>:<widget>:<op>, the console action every other surface uses (REST /api/plugins/toolbar-widgets/widgets…, MCP toolbar_widgets_*, axf toolbar widgets …). The toolbar and the widget are named in words; the console resolves them (matchToolbarInstance, findToolbarWidget).

phrases: attach the <widget> widget to the <toolbar> toolbar
add the <widget> to the <toolbar> toolbar at the start
remove the <widget> widget from the <toolbar> toolbar
move the <widget> to the end of the <toolbar> toolbar
put the <widget> at the start of the <toolbar> toolbar
make the <widget> on the <toolbar> toolbar icon only
make the <widget> on the <toolbar> toolbar wide
